name: Stability Ball Stir the Pot
steps: Set up in a forearm plank with your elbows resting on a stability ball, hands clasped, and feet planted slightly wider than hip-width.
Brace your abs and glutes tightly so your torso and hips remain completely rigid in a straight line.
Move your forearms slowly in a small controlled circle on top of the ball without letting your hips shift or sag.
Complete smooth circles in one direction and reverse directions cleanly while holding your trunk still.
tips: Keep your rib cage down and glutes squeezed so all motion happens strictly through your shoulders and arms.
Start with small slow circles and widen the radius only while your lower back stays completely neutral.
